motivation: The existing V3 closure gate requires a difference to be both practically large and statistically significant before counting a pair as a failure. Non-significance is not evidence of equivalence and can reward low power. Closure is an equivalence claim and therefore requires a direct equivalence audit.

margins_inherited_without_change.domain_scale_floors: Use the exact DOMAIN_SCALE_FLOOR values from analyze_distributional_closure_v3.py.

uncertainty_method.bootstrap: Paired branch-index bootstrap within each matched microstate pair; left and right are resampled with the same branch indices to preserve common-random-number pairing.
uncertainty_method.confidence_rule: Use the 95th percentile as a one-sided upper confidence bound and the 5th percentile as a lower confidence bound for each nonnegative discrepancy metric.
uncertainty_method.scale_rule: Hold each observed pair/outcome normalization scale fixed during bootstrap; do not re-estimate the practical margin per replicate.

pair_classification.equivalent: For viability, the upper 95% bound on absolute risk difference is <=0.15. For every continuous outcome, upper 95% bounds on both standardized absolute mean difference and normalized Wasserstein distance are <=0.25.
pair_classification.demonstrably_non_equivalent: For any outcome, the lower 95% bound exceeds its practical margin for absolute risk difference, standardized absolute mean difference, or normalized Wasserstein distance.

sequential_precision_rule.condition: If the 32-branch fresh overlap run has zero demonstrably non-equivalent pairs but fails the equivalence gate only because too many pairs are inconclusive, branch count may be increased prospectively to 128 on the exact same matched-pair support and candidate state.
sequential_precision_rule.forbidden_rescue: If any pair is demonstrably non-equivalent at 32 branches, do not use branch escalation to call the candidate closed; treat the candidate as failed and diagnose omitted state on a new contract.
sequential_precision_rule.branch_expansion_interpretation: Additional branches increase precision only. Pair selection, state definition, margins, outcomes, horizons, and matching support may not change.

interpretation_guard: The legacy V3 significance gate remains reported for continuity but is no longer sufficient by itself for a scientific closure certificate. This audit applies only to the tested synthetic live-support regime and 30-day horizon.
